Name: CropInstantPickup
Author: xingxiX
Description:
[heading][b]简介[/b][/heading]
这个 mod 让掉落物不再满地乱飞，而是[b]直接进入你的背包[/b]。
名字虽然叫「农作物立刻拾取」，一开始只有农作物和果树，但是修修补补最后干脆全都加上了（，包括打怪、砍树、挖矿等
[heading]功能一览[/heading]
[table][tr][th]功能[/th]
[th]默认[/th]
[th]说明[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]农作物立刻拾取[/td]
[td]开[/td]
[td]收获的作物直接进背包[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]果树果实立刻拾取[/td]
[td]开[/td]
[td]摇果树果实直接进入背包[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]矿石立刻拾取[/td]
[td]关[/td]
[td]石头、矿石的掉落直接进背包（不包括大石头这些）[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]杂草立刻拾取[/td]
[td]关[/td]
[td]割草的掉落直接进背包[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]资源丛立刻拾取[/td]
[td]关[/td]
[td]树桩、原木、大石头、陨石等[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]可破坏容器立刻拾取[/td]
[td]关[/td]
[td]矿洞里的木箱与木桶[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]砍树立刻拾取[/td]
[td]关[/td]
[td]砍倒树的木头、树液、硬木、种子等直接进背包[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]杀怪立刻拾取[/td]
[td]关[/td]
[td]怪物掉落直接进背包[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]灌木丛立刻拾取[/td]
[td]关[/td]
[td]摸灌木丛的掉落（比如茶苗）直接进入背包[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]FTM怪物立刻拾取[/td]
[td]关[/td]
[td]FTM怪物的自定义掉落比如RSV的灵魂精华[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]补给箱立刻拾取[/td]
[td]关[/td]
[td]海滩农场的补给箱[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[heading]说明[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]大石头，树桩这些占地多格的属于资源丛，因此有一个单独的开关[/*]
[*]燃烧弹戒指炸掉的矿石和石头属于矿石开关管理（虽然是和怪物掉落一起算的，但是我给他摘出来了，感觉算矿石好一点？）[/*]
[*]背包满了仍然会变成原版掉落物，没注意背包容量还是有可能被超多的掉落物卡住（也许可以配合加堆叠上限的mod？）[/*]
[*]兼容拖拉机Tractor mod，果树大修Fruit Trees Reforged，Farming Level Affects Harvest等[/*]
[*]多人游戏有待完善，爆炸相关及FTM怪物掉落仅主机有效；[/*]
[/list][heading]安装[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]安装 SMAPI 4.0.0 或更高版本。[/*]
[*]下载并解压到
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]。[/*]
[*]（可选）安装 Generic Mod Config Menu，在游戏内调整开关。[/*]
[/list][heading]源代码[/heading]
[list]
[*]源码 [url=https://github.com/xingxix/StardewValley-CropInstantPickup]https://github.com/xingxix/StardewValley-CropInstantPickup[/url][/*]
[/list][line]

[heading]About[/heading]
This mod makes item drops skip the ground and go straight into your inventory.
Despite the name "Crop Instant Pickup" — it started out with only crops and fruit trees, but after enough patching it ended up covering just about everything, including monster drops, tree chopping, mining, and more.
[heading]Features[/heading]


[table][tr][th]Feature[/th]
[th]Default[/th]
[th]Description[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Instant crop pickup[/td]
[td]On[/td]
[td]Harvested crops go straight into your inventory[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Instant fruit tree pickup[/td]
[td]On[/td]
[td]Shaken fruit goes straight into your inventory[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Instant mining pickup[/td]
[td]Off[/td]
[td]Drops from stones and ores go straight into your inventory (boulders and other resource clumps are not included)[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Instant weed pickup[/td]
[td]Off[/td]
[td]Drops from cutting weeds go straight into your inventory[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Instant resource clump pickup[/td]
[td]Off[/td]
[td]Stumps, logs, boulders, meteorites, etc.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Instant breakable container pickup[/td]
[td]Off[/td]
[td]Crates and barrels in the mines[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Instant tree chopping pickup[/td]
[td]Off[/td]
[td]Wood, sap, hardwood, and seeds from felled trees go straight into your inventory[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Instant monster drop pickup[/td]
[td]Off[/td]
[td]Monster drops go straight into your inventory[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Instant bush pickup[/td]
[td]Off[/td]
[td]Drops from shaking bushes (e.g. tea saplings) go straight into your inventory[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Instant FTM monster drop pickup[/td]
[td]Off[/td]
[td]Custom drops from FTM monsters, such as RSV's Soul Essence[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Instant supply crate pickup[/td]
[td]Off[/td]
[td]Supply crates on the Beach Farm[/td]
[/tr]
[/table][heading]Notes[/heading]
[list]
[*]Boulders, stumps, and other multi-tile objects are resource clumps, so they get their own toggle.[/*]
[*]Ore and stone destroyed by the Napalm Ring are handled by the mining toggle (they're technically rolled together with monster drops, but I pulled them out — they feel more like mining, don't they?).[/*]
[*]If your inventory is full, items remain as vanilla ground drops — if you're not careful with inventory space, a huge pile of drops can still cause lag (maybe pair this with a mod that raises stack limits?).[/*]
[*]Compatible with Tractor Mod, Fruit Trees Reforged, Farming Level Affects Harvest, and more.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer is still a work in progress. Explosion-related pickups and FTM monster drops only work on the host.[/*]
[/list][heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher.[/*]
[*]Download and unzip into
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][/*]
[*](Optional) Install Generic Mod Config Menu to toggle features in-game.[/*]
[/list][heading]Source[/heading]
Source code: [url=https://github.com/xingxix/StardewValley-CropInstantPickup]https://github.com/xingxix/StardewValley-CropInstantPickup[/url]
[line]
